requiredFindings.resolution: Every new refusal is a route REFERENCE (params.route.routeKey) to public-route-successor.v1.json: three internal keys with domainDetail absent under the existing public-route law, errorCode REQUEST.PRECONDITION_FAILED, two envelope-only DomainDetailCode members with remedies, one new origin value, owner selectors (function source digests), timing anchors and route-table rows. check.py applies the published rows in memory to the pinned model and derives class, errorCode, exit, envelope detail and carrier with public_termination_for, failure_envelope_errors and CLASS_TO_EXIT; it validates against the real StepTermination and DomainDetail schemas (the registry file is now pinned); it requires the owner request-precondition family and executes the selectors wrapping dependency_source_set_admit and prepared_output_set_admit.

DEPSRC-SET-KEY-CONSTRAINTS and DEPSRC-WIRE-REPRESENTABILITY run in the dependency-source set admission successor (owner-admitted sets only): non-NFC name/version/sourceId/path, <= U+0020 in name/version, key > 4096, path > 4096 scalars or failing canonical-path-segments refuse; nothing normalized. REQUEST-WIRE-ACCOUNTING plans exact deterministic-CBOR envelope payload bytes (40-byte prefix excluded per rust2 framing/aggregateAccounting), refuses any planned frame over maxFramePayloadBytes and, for major 3, totals over maxRequestPayloadBytesTotal/maxRequestFrames; boundary vectors at exactly 67108864 frame bytes, 9663676416 request bytes and a frame-count limit, without materializing chunk bytes (ByteLen accounting validated against the owner encoder).

patternDialect is structured; patternSites (13 wire + 41 extern sites) and loweringRequired are closed lists with location, pattern, negation and constructs, asserted equal to the closure recomputed from the pinned schemas; carriers and extern JSON Schema validation evaluate patterns through the ECMA-262 translation, differential-checked against pinned Node 24.16.0 over every site and a line-terminator corpus, and the review-02 engine output is replayed.
